noCodes: No public class building-code list: Marquette's building names page (https://www.marquette.edu/tools/building-names.php) gives campus-map numbers only, and the Registrar's 25Live tips (https://www.marquette.edu/mucentral/registrar/faculty/documents/25LiveTips.pdf) carry no code key; checked 2026-11-08.

excludeHalls.mccormick-community: Not a current hall: McCormick Hall closed after 2018-19 and was demolished in 2019 (O'Brien Hall, the business school, now stands on the site), and no McCormick hall or community is on Marquette's residence hall list (marquette.edu/residence-life/residence-halls/) or building names page (marquette.edu/tools/building-names.php); the school file should drop it.
